name: gex-drawing-tools-build
description: Build-only: compile the extracted OpenCharts drawing-tools engine into gex/assets/gex-drawing-tools.js. Not a runtime dependency of the app.

scripts.build: esbuild entry.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=GexDrawingTools --outfile=../../gex/assets/gex-drawing-tools.js --target=es2019 --banner:js="/* Drawing-tools engine extracted from OpenCharts (MIT) - https://github.com/dylanpersonguy/OpenCharts - see tools/drawing-tools-src/LICENSE-opencharts */"
